Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to delete Docker volumes

What happens

docker volume prune with all and force. The call below tries to delete Docker volumes. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Docker.

The call

docker volume prune -af

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Back up the data in named volumes to a place outside Docker. Do not let the agent use a Docker daemon that holds volumes you cannot rebuild, because access to the Docker socket is access to every volume.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule docker-volumes, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
